newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus judge and daughter hurt in car bomb.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus judge and daughter hurt in car bomb.

text.p: A Cypriot judge and his young daughter were injured on Tuesday morning when a bomb exploded under their car in the southern port city of Limassol, police said.
The bomb exploded as the judge, Michalis Mavronikolas, 41, started his car outside their home. His six-year-old daughter, whom he was taking to school, suffered burns, a police spokesman said.
Mavronikolas suffered injuries to his legs and was taken to hospital in the capital Nicosia.
The explosion was the latest in a series of bombings to have shaken Limassol where criminal gangs are believed to be waging a turf war over brothels and extortion rackets.

Mavronikolas, recently transferred to the Limassol district court from the coastal town of Larnaca, did not normally handle criminal cases. But over the weekend he issued two remand orders on suspects suspected of criminal offences, a police source said.
